$DFS(G):$
$unmark \text{ all } v \in V$
$t \gets 0$
$for \text{ each } v \in V$
$if \text{ } v \text{ is unmarked}$
$t \gets Explore(G, v, t)$
$end \text{ } if$
$end \text{ } for$

$Explore(G, v, t):$
$mark \text{ } v$
$t \gets t + 1$
$d[v] \gets t$
$for \text{ each } (v, w) \in E$
$if \text{ } w \text{ is unmarked}$
$t \gets Explore(G, w, t)$
$end \text{ } if$
$end \text{ } for$
$t \gets t + 1$
$f[v] \gets t$
$return \text{ } t$
